Our Services White's Bodyworks is a specialist vehicle bodywork, repair and restoration workshop in West Sussex, working on modern cars, classic vehicles and motorcycles. Our services include accident and body repairs, welding and fabrication, paintwork and resprays, mechanical work, servicing and full or partial restoration projects. Choose a service area below to find the most relevant starting point for your vehicle. Car Bodywork, Repair & Paint Services in Sussex Motorbike Services in Sussex Classic Car & Motorcycle Services in Sussex Our Experience 500 + Projects completed £ 20 k Average project value 500 + Happy customers 100 + Years experience A little about us Why White's Bodyworks? White's Bodyworks combines body repair, fabrication, welding, paint and mechanical work under one roof, which means more complex jobs can be assessed and repaired as a whole rather than passed between several different specialists. We work on modern cars, classic vehicles and motorcycles, from localised repairs and paintwork to structural corrosion, accident damage and full restoration projects. Our approach starts with understanding what is actually needed. That might mean preserving and repairing an original panel, fabricating an unavailable section, carrying out structural work before paint, or advising that a smaller repair is more sensible than a larger restoration. Based near Hassocks in West Sussex, we work with customers across Sussex and the wider South East on both everyday vehicles and specialist projects. Contact us Terms of Service Portfolio View more of our recent projects. At White's Bodyworks, we believe in transparency and clarity when it comes to our pricing structure and the terms governing our services. Below, you'll find detailed information about our fees, booking process, and what you can expect when working with us. When it comes to estimating costs for our services, we operate with a focus on transparency and accuracy. However, due to the diverse nature of projects and the multitude of variables involved, we can only provide top-end and bottom-end estimates. These estimates serve as a guideline, encompassing the range of potential costs based on various factors such as the complexity of the work, materials required, and unforeseen circumstances. Rest assured, we strive to provide the most accurate estimate possible while ensuring flexibility to accommodate the unique needs of each project. May involve minimal to moderate fabrication work. Images taken throughout the process. Booking Fee: £250 (non-refundable, deductible from total works) Please note: The total cost for works will depend on the actual time taken for completion, which will be billed at the applicable hourly rate. Images will be taken throughout the process for your reference and documentation. We will keep you updated on the funds in your account as work progresses. We work on a ‘money on account’ basis. So once your vehicle has arrived, you will be required to top-up the account for works. We’ll keep you up to speed on funds as we go through the works.
